headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and security checks to improve ClearInstall's risk assessment capabilities, ensuring users are aware of potential vulnerabilities before installation. Leverage machine learning for predictive analytics on package risks, and incorporate user feedback mechanisms to continuously refine the tool’s accuracy.
